closed_reductions.d_ladder_firewall: any proof using O(d) independent y-powers is rejected because it breaks Burgess uniformity
closed_reductions.degree_bookkeeping_imported: previous Stepanov degree/multiplicity contradiction applies after selector rank is available
closed_reductions.jet_bookkeeping: multiplicity T at N points consumes a predictable number of Hasse-jet linear conditions once a selector exists
closed_reductions.rank_gap_relocalized: the old nonzero-rank gate is now a finite branch-signature selector plus Hasse-jet independence problem

normalized_rank_problem.allowed_dimension_source: use branch valuation signatures and Hasse derivatives whose constants depend only on m
normalized_rank_problem.auxiliary_space_goal: construct a bounded-pole auxiliary space with dimension growing like c_m*D and rank loss O_m(T*N)
normalized_rank_problem.forbidden_dimension_source: do not use the full y^d=f(x) monomial ladder; it has d-dependent dimension/genus
normalized_rank_problem.input: branch divisor B={a_1,...,a_m}, signed exponents e_a, character order d, f not a d-th power
normalized_rank_problem.surjectivity_goal: after imposing Hasse-jet vanishing conditions, a nonzero function remains on the Kummer eigenspace

plain_conclusion: Stepanov-Kummer 非零秩输入继续缩窄。现在的硬点不再是笼统的辅助多项式存在性，而是一个阶无关的分支签名选择问题：必须在只允许常数依赖分支数 `m<=2r`、不允许依赖角色阶 `d` 的条件下，构造足够多的辅助函数签名，并证明 Hasse-jet 插值条件只造成 `O_m(TN)` 的秩损耗。本步闭合了三件事：把秩问题重定位到分支估值签名，排除使用整条 Kummer 曲线 `y^0,...,y^{d-1}` 全梯子的 d 依赖伪证明，并固定 Hasse-jet 条件的记账接口。唯一剩余变为 `OrderFreeKummerSignatureSelectorAndHasseJetRankLemma`。未证明该签名选择引理前，Stepanov、Kummer 迹界、Weil 界、B4 和行/列命题仍不能作者侧无条件闭合。

remaining_selector.if_proved: StepanovKummerAuxiliaryPolynomialNonzeroRankSurjectivity closes, then the Kummer trace and Burgess B4 chain can continue
remaining_selector.jet_statement: the Hasse-jet evaluation matrix on that family has rank loss bounded by C_m*T*N
remaining_selector.selector_statement: for every non-dth-power f with m branch places, find an order-free family of auxiliary signatures with rank >= c_m*D after all Kummer relations
remaining_selector.why_not_closed_here: the corpus still lacks a proof that such a selector exists uniformly for all exponent residue patterns e_a mod d

rows.meaning: 上一证书已把唯一剩余压成 Stepanov-Kummer 辅助空间非零秩。
非零秩问题已重定位为分支估值签名选择与 Hasse-jet 独立性。
已排除用 `y^0,...,y^{d-1}` 全梯子制造维数的 d 依赖路线。
辅助函数的可区分性可由分支估值签名记录，碰撞只来自全分支不可见差。
一旦有阶无关签名族，Hasse-jet 条件的秩损耗可按 `O_m(TN)` 记账。
仍需证明所有 exponent residue pattern 下都存在足够大的阶无关签名选择族。
Stepanov-Kummer 非零秩等待签名选择与 Hasse-jet 秩引理。
Stepanov 完整证明仍未作者侧闭合。
秩一 Kummer 迹界仍等待 Stepanov rank gate。
本步只把非零秩问题压成签名选择原子，不声明行/列命题无条件闭合。

signature_normal_form.collision_rule: two auxiliary monomials can collapse only if their signature difference is invisible at every branch place
signature_normal_form.local_derivatives: Hasse derivatives change local signatures by controlled bounded amounts, so jet conditions consume O_m(T) signatures per point
signature_normal_form.nonpower_anchor: because f is not a d-th power, at least one branch coordinate carries a nonzero residue signature
signature_normal_form.order_free_requirement: the chosen signature family must have size and separation bounded below in terms of m, not d
